controller.description: M10 serial-leg cascade: the M9 sensor-only cascade with the pitch-rate gains lowered from 0.15 / 0.13 (hold / drive) to 0.07. With the 5 ms sensor transport delay, the M9 rate gains drive a ~19 Hz oscillation through the knee-belt compliance (wheel torque reacts on the shin, which the 1:1 knee belt holds): the tires hop, the airborne wheels spin up and corrupt the velocity estimate. Physical limits and acceptance thresholds are not changed by tuning. Phase C6: a whole-robot momentum observer (slope_observer_tau_s) compares the wheel torque before friction compensation with the CoM momentum (axle velocity plus the rate of the CoM's horizontal offset) and adds the static slope lean, bounded by slope_feedforward_limit_rad and slew limited by slope_lean_rate_limit_rad_s so a push cannot step it. The hold integral limit rises from 0.3 to 1.0 so the integral can trim the remaining slope error. M12 phase B (speed envelope to 1.2 m/s): the velocity reference is jerk limited (command_jerk_m_s3) at the 1.25 m/s^2 envelope acceleration (max_command_acceleration, was 3) and the lean reference adds atan(a/g) of the reference acceleration (acceleration_feedforward); a stop brakes the reference to rest and holds there. Tuning: artifacts/m12/speed/tuning/tuning.json.
